_nguon: TT 40/2026/TT-BXD ngay 26/6/2026 (ban nguoi dung cung cap 15/10/2026, da doi chieu): Bang 2.2, 2.3, 2.4 PL II; Bang 4 PL IV. PL VIII TT 38/2026 (bo phu luc thay the CV 9947): Bang 1.1 dinh muc chi phi QLDA.

bang_2_2_gian_tiep_tren_nc._ghi_chu: Chi phi gian tiep = NC trong T x ty le; nac theo tong NC trong chi phi truc tiep cua du toan thuc hien bao duong/sua chua cua cong trinh (ty dong). Vung nui, bien gioi, tren bien, hai dao: he so 1,05 - 1,1 tuy dieu kien.

bang_2_4_nha_tam._ghi_chu: LT = chi phi thuc hien sau thue x ty le; nac theo tong chi phi thuc hien bao duong (sua chua) truoc thue cua cong trinh (ty dong).

bang_4_quan_ly_chu_so_huu._ghi_chu: GQL = (GBDTT + GSCTT) x ty le; quy mo = chi phi thuc hien bao duong va sua chua theo ke hoach bao tri (chua GTGT, ty dong). Toi thieu 2.000.000 dong. TT 40 khong ghi cong thuc noi suy - skill noi suy tuyen tinh nhu PL VIII TT 38, can xac nhan.

pl8_tt38_bang_1_1_qlda._ghi_chu: Chi phi QLDA = (Cxd + Ctb chua GTGT) x Nt x tich he so k. Noi suy tuyen tinh giua hai moc (PL VIII muc 1 Phan I). He so (Chuong I muc 1.3-1.5): bien/dao/bien gioi/xa DBKK k=1,35; tuyen tu 2 tinh tro len hoac nhieu cong trinh o nhieu tinh k=1,1; chu dau tu tu thuc hien QLDA (Dieu 48 ND quan ly hoat dong xay dung) k=0,8; chi phi thiet bi >= 50% k=0,8. Chua gom du phong va chi phi CDT truc tiep tham dinh (tinh bo sung).
